title: Quilt Patterns
tagline: Piece traditional quilt blocks and design a quilt, one fabric at a time.
description: A calm design puzzle about quilting. Stitch printed fabrics into six traditional blocks, meet briefs about contrast, balance and repeat, then arrange blocks into a quilt top with sashing and a border. Lessons, hints that explain, a Squint tool for value, Free Studio and a Gallery.
howToPlay: Tap a fabric in the tray, then tap or drag across the pieces of the block.
Meet every rule on the brief card, or copy the sample exactly.
Use Squint to see light and dark, and the bulb for a hint that explains.
Arrange finished blocks into a quilt, then add sashing and a border.
Watch and Learn designs a block and a quilt and explains each choice.
